title: Build Adjacency Matrix
description: Construct the adjacency matrix A from the graph structure where A[i][j] = 1 if edge exists, 0 otherwise. For weighted graphs, use actual edge weights.

title: Initialize Centrality Vector
description: Start with a uniform centrality score of 1/N for all N nodes, or optionally use degree-based initialization for faster convergence.

title: Power Iteration
description: Multiply the adjacency matrix by the current centrality vector: x_new = A · x_current. This distributes each node's centrality to its neighbors.

title: Normalize the Vector
description: Normalize the resulting vector (typically L2 normalization to unit length) to prevent values from growing unbounded. The ratio between iterations approaches the dominant eigenvalue.

title: Check Convergence
description: Compare consecutive centrality vectors. If the change (e.g., L2 norm of difference) falls below a threshold, stop. Otherwise continue iterating.

title: Extract Final Scores
description: The converged vector represents the eigenvector centrality scores, proportional to the sum of neighbors' centralities.
